psf_context.gap_read: A 'sweet-spot' ~1,180-1,320 sqft 3BR at $2.2M needs <=~$1,670-1,860 psf. D19 Bartley-Serangoon FH trades right at/below that -> passes cluster there. D14 Eunos/Paya Lebar older stock ($1,600-1,880) is within reach but thin in-band supply. D15 prime FH at $2,300+ psf is a $450-900 psf gap above cap - only D15's cheaper edges (Elliot/Siglap/Flamingo/Seawind) or a boutique squeeze (Carpmael at the ceiling) can fit.

duplicates_or_data_quality_notes: All portals (PropertyGuru, 99.co, SRX, EdgeProp, PropNex) returned HTTP 403 on direct WebFetch this run. Every figure is triangulated from search-index snippets of those pages, not live-scraped inventory. Treat active-listing counts and live prices as indicative - verify on-portal before acting.

Bliss @ Kovan $2.2M / 1,765 sqft penthouse and Flamingo Valley $2.0M / 1,701 sqft listing are both unchanged from the June baseline and may be persistent/stale rather than fresh supply. Flamingo Valley remains a flagged PSF outlier.
